# load reference signatures (SPE results)

Load mSigAct signature attribution and prep for enrichment analysis
```{r}
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/wga_uc_cosmic_srWGA.rda")

## Signature attribution result
mSigAct_pd <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  'rownames<-' (gsub(pattern = "PBMC::", replacement = "", x = rownames(.))) %>%
  'rownames<-' (gsub(pattern = "-cell", replacement = "", x = rownames(.))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("WGA", rownames(.))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>% 
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))),
         type = gsub(pattern = "^[^_]*_", replacement = "", x = Samples)) %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(type == "myeloid_1", "Myeloid_1", type)) %>%
  mutate(type = gsub(pattern = "\\_", replacement = "", x = type)) %>%
  mutate(type = gsub(pattern = "Myeloid", replacement = "M", x = type))

## Factor level
sample.order <- c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34")
mSigAct_pd$group <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$group, levels = sample.order)
mSigAct_pd$type <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$type, 
                        levels = c("B1", "B2", "B5", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T4b", "T6", "T7", "NK1", "NK2", "NK3", 
                                   "M1", "M2"))
mSigAct_pd$signatures <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$signatures, 
                                levels = c("SBS1",  "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS36", "SBS45", "SBS95"))

## create batchPch column to indicate batches. 
mSigAct_pd$batchPch<-NA
mSigAct_pd$batchPch[grep("UC4_|UC5_|UC7_|UC14_T-cell_4",mSigAct_pd$Samples)]<- "Batch1"
mSigAct_pd$batchPch[grepl("UC14_",mSigAct_pd$Samples) & !mSigAct_pd$Samples == "UC14_T-cell_4"]<- "Batch2"
mSigAct_pd$batchPch[grep("UC18_|UC34_",mSigAct_pd$Samples)]<- "Batch3"

mSigAct_pd <- mSigAct_pd %>% mutate(celltype = case_when(grepl("T", type) ~ "T-cell",
                                                         grepl("B", type) ~ "B-cell",
                                                         grepl("NK", type) ~ "NK-cell",
                                                         grepl("M", type) ~ "Myeloid"))

## Factor order
mSigAct_pd$celltype <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$celltype, levels = c("B-cell", "T-cell", "NK-cell", "Myeloid"))
```

Enrichment analysis for batch using fishers test
```{r}
batch <- unique(mSigAct_pd$batchPch) ## Batches
signatures <- unique(as.character(mSigAct_pd$signatures)) ## Signatures

# Haldane–Anscombe correction
ha_or <- function(tab) {
  stopifnot(all(dim(tab) == c(2, 2)))
  tab <- tab + 0.5 ## Add 0.5 to account for zero cell count

  or <- (tab[2,2] * tab[1,1]) /
        (tab[2,1] * tab[1,2])

  return(or)
  }

## For loop to perform fishers test for enrichment between batch and background for a signature
res <- list()

for (b in batch) {
  for(s in signatures) {
    sel_df <- mSigAct_pd %>% dplyr::filter(signatures == s) %>%
      mutate(status = ifelse(value > 0.05, 1, 0),
             obsBatch = ifelse(batchPch == b, 1, 0))
    tab <- table(sel_df$obsBatch,
                 sel_df$status)
    ft <- fisher.test(tab)
    
    or_ha <- ha_or(tab)
  
    case <- paste(b, s, sep = "_")
    
    res[[case]] <- data.frame(
      Batch = b,
      Signatures = s,
      odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
      or_ha = or_ha,
      lower_CI = ft$conf.int[1],
      upper_CI = ft$conf.int[2],
      p_value = ft$p.value)
  }
}

res <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, res))
res$FDR <- p.adjust(res$p_value, method = "BH") ## FDR 
```

Plotting results
```{r}
xmin <- 1e-4 ## left side minimum xlimit (0's CI don't work)
xmax <- 10000 ## Right side maximum xlimit (because some go to INF)

plot_df <- res %>%
  mutate(
    OR_plot = or_ha, 
    upper_plot = pmin(upper_CI, xmax), ## If greater than xmax then set to xmax
    inf = is.infinite(upper_CI)
  )

plot_df$lower_CI[plot_df$lower_CI == 0] <- xmin  # 0 to 1e-4 so doesnt get affected by log10 transformation

## Factor order
plot_df$Signatures <- factor(x = plot_df$Signatures, 
                             levels = rev(c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS36", "SBS45", "SBS95")))

p2 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = OR_plot, y = Signatures)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_CI,
                     xmax = upper_plot),
                 height = 0.2,
                 linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(.~Batch) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = 10^(-4:4), labels = -4:4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ## Arrow for infinite CI
  geom_segment(
    data = subset(plot_df, inf),
    aes(x = xmax * 0.8,
        xend = xmax * 0.85,
        y = Signatures,
        yend = Signatures),
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed",
                  length = unit(0.1, "cm")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  xlab(expression("log"[10]*"(OR)")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0))
p2
```

How many SBS95 positives?
```{r}
sbs95 <- mSigAct_pd %>% dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS95") %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(value > 0.05, 1, 0))

table(sbs95$celltype, sbs95$status)

sbs95$lineage <- ifelse(sbs95$celltype == "Myeloid", "Myeloid", "Lymphoid")

onlypositives <- sbs95 %>% dplyr::filter(status == 1) 

wilcox.test(value ~ lineage, data = onlypositives)

onlypositives %>% dplyr::group_by(lineage) %>% dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(value))
```
